lines.zh: 我摆尾，往上游挪了一尺。
lines.en: One tail beat carries me a foot upstream.
I turn with the shoal.
Water passes over my gills.
I swim close to the sandy bottom.

lines.zh: 我钻过沉木底下的空隙。
lines.en: I slip through the gap under a sunken log.
The water shallows and my back breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流滑过一片卵石。
lines.en: I glide with the current over pebbles.

lines.zh: 我们一群往同一个方向。
lines.en: The shoal moves one way.
My tail fin opens and closes.
I thread between two stones.

lines.zh: 水温变凉了，我往深处去。
lines.en: The water cools; I head deeper.

lines.zh: 我跟着一片落叶漂了一段。
lines.en: I drift along with a fallen leaf.

lines.zh: 我贴着水草根，尾巴轻摆。
lines.en: I hug the weed roots, tail swaying.
The weed is much taller than I am.
I circle twice among the weed.
I come back to the shoal.

lines.zh: 我停在河床，鳃盖轻轻扇动。
lines.en: I hold on the riverbed, gill covers fanning.

lines.zh: 阳光透过水面，照出条纹。
lines.en: Sun comes through the surface in stripes.

lines.zh: 我摆尾，搅起河底的细沙。
lines.en: I flick my tail, stirring the riverbed sand.
The others hold still beside me.
The bottom is flat, and pleasant to look at.
Something drifts down from upstream.
I turn on my side and let it pass.
My scales are small and close-set.
Shadows waver on the surface.

lines.zh: 我在同一块石头旁待了很久。
lines.en: I have stayed by the same stone a long while.

lines.zh: 我缩在沉木影子里，不起眼。
lines.en: I stay in the sunken log's shade, unnoticed.
I sink a hand's depth.
The water settles again.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆回原位，干涸河床的鱼群里。
lines.en: I drift back into place among the dry riverbed school.
You stand in the water and mud rises at your feet.
I swim between your legs.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了一大片。
lines.en: Your shadow covers a wide patch.
I stop at the shadow's edge.
You bend down and the water moves.
The shoal breaks and re-forms.
You are watching me. I do not much mind.
I really am just a small fish.
You reach, and I am gone.

lines.zh: 从水草后面我又探出来。
lines.en: Then I peek out from behind the weed.
One hard tail beat and I shoot away.
My gill covers flare wide.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，肚皮朝上漂。
lines.en: I flip over, belly up, drifting.
A scale has come off.
I spin in the water.
The whole shoal bursts apart.
A few of my scales are scraped off.
One fin is a little crooked.
I slowly right myself.
The water still flows on.
Something sinks. Food.
I swim over and circle it.
The others come as well.
We crowd and snatch at it.
That mouthful was tiny — not enough.
Another morsel sinks.
I turn back for it.
There is a hand above. I do not go up.
I wait below.
It will sink in time.

lines.zh: 你的脚碰到我，我弹开了。
lines.en: Your foot touches me and I dart away.

lines.zh: 我撞到同伴，我们一起转。
lines.en: I bump a shoal-mate and we both turn.

lines.zh: 干涸河床的小鱼，成群游。
lines.en: Little fish, schooling in a dry riverbed.
I slip away along the stone.
That frightened me badly.
I hide in the weed.
A while later I come out.

lines.zh: 干河床里，我们挤成一团。
lines.en: In the dry riverbed, we bunch together.

lines.zh: 我慢慢游回原来的位置。
lines.en: I drift back to where I was.
The water clears, and I am easy.
The water is right, and we gather.
The shoal crowds around a patch of weed.

lines.zh: 干河床的积水里，我们挤成一团。
lines.en: In a puddle of the dry riverbed, we crowd together.

lines.zh: 水里有很细的颗粒散开。
lines.en: Very fine grains drift in the water.
Those will become small fish.

lines.zh: 我们自己不知道具体是哪一条。
lines.en: None of us knows which one.
It does not matter.
The weed will shelter them.
We scatter, each swimming off.
The river is still the river.
I try to take it in my mouth.
Too large to hold.
We school in the dried riverbed.
It sinks faster.
I give up and swim off.
The others will not eat it either.
In the dry riverbed, only stones.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，又回来看了看。
lines.en: I circle once and come back to look.
Then I swim off again.
Nothing here worth staying for.
Small insects move in the water.

lines.zh: 干涸的河床上，我们挤成一团。
lines.en: On the dry riverbed we school tight.
The shoal turns too.
We swim over together.
I open my mouth and water rushes in.
I sift the water once.
There is something in it.
But not enough to eat.
Something else falls from above.
I lift my mouth a little.
It lands right at my mouth.

lines.zh: 一只小虫落水，我冲了上去。
lines.en: An insect hits the water and I dart up.

lines.zh: 我盯着那片水里的小点。
lines.en: I fix on the flecks in the water.
The flecks scatter.
I swim at a different angle.

lines.zh: 鱼群贴着河床一齐转向。
lines.en: The school turns as one along the riverbed.
They are caught between us.
I open my mouth and sift as I swim.
Water leaves through my gills.
What was in the water stays.
I turn back around.
One more sift.
A few are still there.
A third pass and there is nothing.
We disperse.
I swallow it down without chewing.
So small I cannot taste it.
I dart at another cluster.
I churn a small eddy.
One mouthful at a time, slowly.
When I am full I stop moving.
I hang midwater.
My fins need only stir.
The others are still feeding.
I hang without moving.
Sun is on my back.

lines.zh: 我撞开一条小鱼，抢它的位置。
lines.en: I bump a smaller fish aside to take its spot.

lines.zh: 一尾鱼从泥里翻出来，是我。
lines.en: A fish flips out of the mud — that's me.
On this dry riverbed we swim as a school.

lines.zh: 我第一次摆尾，就往前走了。
lines.en: One beat of my tail and I am moving.
There is other fish in this water.
I swim toward them.
Soon I have company.
We arrange ourselves one way.
The stones below are green with growth.
I skim over them.

lines.zh: 我从干河床的水洼里冒头。
lines.en: I surface from a pool in the dry riverbed.
I watch from the water.
It will not come into the water.
I swim on.
The river is long. I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 水面像烧起来一样烫，我往深处钻。
lines.en: The surface burns with heat and I dive.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，在石头上乱跳。
lines.en: I am thrown onto the bank and flop on the stones.

lines.zh: 水里没有气，我的鳃拼命开合。
lines.en: There is no breath in the water; my gills work wildly.

lines.zh: 冲击把水和鱼一起掀起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and the fish with it.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进水里，擦过我的侧腹。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and grazes my flank.
Strange light pierces the water and I cannot move.
The water is too clear. Nothing in it.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整条麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and I go numb.

lines.zh: 水忽然没了，我在空中翻。
lines.en: The water vanishes and I tumble in air.
